parts.text: {"status": "confirmed", "title": "Checkout failures spiking", "affected_service": "checkout-service", "symptoms": ["payment timeouts", "elevated 5xx on /checkout"], "incident_start_iso": "2026-08-20T14:32:00Z", "description": "Customers report checkout failing across the board since ~14:32 UTC."}

property.description: spiking_signals includes both checkout-service GatewayTimeoutError and payments-service RetryExhaustedError from the same time window -- the two services' errors co-occur, which is the core correlation signal.
likely_origin_service is payments-service, since its RetryExhaustedError (gateway retries exhausted) is what precedes and explains checkout-service's GatewayTimeoutError, not the other way around.
correlation_notes explains the causal direction -- payments-service exhausting retries against its own upstream gateway is what makes checkout-service's calls to payments-service time out.
